newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yemen hikes Q2 term price for Masila, Marib Light.
newsitem.headline: Yemen hikes Q2 term price for Masila, Marib Light.

text.p: Yemen has raised crude oil term prices for this year's second quarter by 47 cents per barrel for Masila and 15 cents for Marib Light, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The term price for Masila was set at dated Brent minus 50 cents for the April-June period, up 47 cents from the first quarter, when it was set at dated Brent minus 97 cents, they said.
Marib Light's term price was set at dated Brent minus 15 cents, up 15 cents from the January-March period, when it was set at dated Brent minus 30 cents, they said.
The term price for Yemeni crude oil is negotiated prior to the beginning of each quarter.
